movie.title: Bazaar (Murder in the Building)
movie.overview: Misanthropic novelist François writes gripping crime stories – “Agatha Christie meets The Scarlet Pimpernel” – but outside of the swashbuckling imaginary world of his Marquis la Rose-novels, life is far from thrilling. His partner Colette, a professor at the Sorbonne and world-renowned expert on Alfred Hitchcock, is tired of watching François sit around their apartment in his pyjamas and yearns for the excitement of the classic films she watches with her students. When Colette begins to suspect their flamboyant actor neighbour of murdering his wife, the couple’s mundane lives are turned upside down – and their stale relationship is jolted back to life.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a misanthropic novelist and his film professor partner suspect their flamboyant neighbor of murder, their dull routines and languishing relationship are wildly reignited.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: François is an uninspired crime novelist who spends his days lounging in pyjamas, while his partner Colette is a Sorbonne professor obsessed with the suspense of classic Hitchcock films. Stagnating in their domestic routine, the couple's quiet lives take a dramatic turn when Colette begins to suspect their eccentric neighbor has murdered his wife. Joining forces to investigate the mystery, they find that the real-life intrigue is exactly the spark their fading romance needed.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: François, a misanthropic author who writes swashbuckling crime novels featuring 'Marquis la Rose,' lives a thoroughly unexciting life confined to his apartment. His partner, Colette, is an esteemed Sorbonne professor and Alfred Hitchcock expert who grows increasingly frustrated with François's lethargy and craves the thrilling suspense found in her favorite cinema. Their mundane routine is shattered when a flamboyant actor living in their building begins behaving suspiciously following the sudden disappearance of his wife. Driven by her cinematic intuition, Colette becomes convinced that a real-life murder has taken place right under their roof. Initial skepticism gives way as François gets pulled into the amateur investigation, applying his fiction-writing logic to their eccentric neighbor's erratic behavior. As the couple tails their neighbor, uncovers clues, and plays detective, the thrilling game of cat-and-mouse injects fresh energy into their stale relationship. Bridging the gap between fictional intrigue and real-life passion, their shared pursuit of the truth ultimately forces them to re-evaluate both their dynamic and the world outside their apartment walls.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: François is a misanthropic novelist whose swashbuckling crime stories starkly contrast with his uninspired, pyjama-clad reality. His partner, Colette, a Sorbonne professor and world-renowned Alfred Hitchcock expert, yearns for the cinematic intrigue and passion absent from her stagnant domestic life. Everything changes when Colette begins to suspect that their flamboyant actor neighbor has secretly murdered his wife. Thrust into an amateur investigation that feels ripped straight from a suspense film, the couple navigates a maze of real-life mystery and neighborhood drama, discovering that solving a crime together might just be the cure for their dying romance.
